notes.title: Christmas update !!!
notes.content:
Steam people,

We are thrilled to announce that we pushed a new update which includes a number of fixes and improvements.

Most important new feature is the "VR mode": 
Everyone who has a "Stand up/front facing" setup will now be able to comfortably play "La Peri" within their space without taking the risk to hit their mug to get close to her dance, as we now have implemented a "desk mode"!
People who have more space to play with (like an ideal 3x3m Roomscale), will obviously be able to access the standard "Roomscale mode" within the main menu, and unleash their full choreography!
Also, Oculus Rift with Touch controllers are now compatible.

"La Peri" is part of the Christmas sales, so we have a 50% off, promo until january 3rd!

And last but no least we have a beautiful artwork to celebrate the joy of Christmas with our favorite Dancing Characters.

Hope you will enjoy this update and hope to see you soon on stage with la Peri !


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22321322/d65ede3cec13a7bc0e57bc077c8cde368ed786b4.png[/img]

notes.title: "FIREBIRD - La Peri" Final Release & Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22321322/d60d20eae6162885c94c980fad14b736777f5bd4.png[/img]

Hi everybody,

we are now reaching the very last steps before going official on Friday 19th of August. As you can see, first of all, the title has changed and we are happy to announce that La Peri now represents the first installment of a musical/choreography series called FIREBIRD - we like to think of as Fantasia for VR.

[b]// Release Notes //[/b]

General

- English voices have been re-recorded with the actor John Rhys-Davies
- French and Mandarin (simplified) languages have been added
- In-game illustrated book acting as a transcript (subtitles) has been integrated
- Launch menu has been implemented with graphics settings option, language selection, restart and shortcut to end-scene dance
- Enhanced graphics (textures, meshes, particules, animations...)
- Enhanced sound (ambient, feedbacks...)
- UI / UX has been made more comprehensive and intuitive
- Implementation of achievements

Minor bug

- Audio play issues when unfocused window fixed

notes.title: Patch Notes - Last update before release
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]

-  Update to 4.11 (UE4)

 -> hopefully this will fix the issue of the non-working trigger in the tutorial. Please let us know if you still encounter this bug !

- Correction of a few spelling mistakes


[b]Bugs fixing[/b]

- Need to catch twice the bouquet of petals (final choice)

- Wrong positioning of animal spirit petal hitboxes


[b]Visual polishing[/b]

- General ambiance become less dark (especially floor)

- Numerous assets have been reworked

- Stage has been improved visually (details, textures, etc)

- Rework of the in-game controllers, lightorch (left hand) and cage (right hand)

- Particules from caught petals in the cage are now drawing vegetal forms and are graduated in function of player's hand movement speed

- Aura has been added around the bouquet of petals

- Rework of statue modelization and collapse animation

- Modulable skybox during final choice phase


[b]Interactivity[/b]

[i]Intuitivity about actions required:[/i]

- Cage (right hand) is disactivated when not useful

- Setting is destroyed before final act to prevent the player from trying to get petals from the dancer

[i]Petal catching:[/i]

- Animal spirits no longer goes straight on the player 

- Animal spirits animations / reactions are more various

- Chimp petal hitbox has been extended


[b]What's coming next for the final release ?[/b]

- Implementation of an in-game illustrated book on which the voice over will be transcripted (like subtitles). It will also act as a new interactive asset, which gives the ability to the users to decide themselves when they want to go to the next stage.
   
- French, English (new ones) and Chinese voice-over !

- Better transitions in-between scenes instead of fade-to-black

- some mysterious Steam achievements ;)
